text:
Maria Chen: FYI we're onboarding customer AMT4 today. They need dedicated inference capacity across ap-east-1 and eu-central-2 — big initial footprint: 8x p5 (p5.48xlarge) and 12x g5 (g5.48xlarge) spread across 2 AZs. Can we get quotas pre-warmed?

Sahil Kapoor: Ack. Do we have the AWS account IDs and VPCs yet? Also need ENI and vCPU quotas per region — those are usually the blocker.

Maria Chen: Account IDs: 123456789012 (AMT4-prod), 210987654321 (AMT4-staging). VPCs are created but not peered. I'll paste the VPC ids in a sec. Expecting sustained low-latency loads so we want on-demand for critical tiers.

Andrew Park: I'll open the support cases. For quota requests we should ask for:
- EC2 On-Demand p5.48xlarge quota increase to 8
- EC2 On-Demand g5.48xlarge quota increase to 12
- ENIs per region bumped to 2000
- vCPU quota bump to cover the instances
- EFA / elastic network adapter availability — request high performance placement

Sahil Kapoor: Also request increased "Security groups per ENI" and "IPv4 addresses per ENI"? AMT4 uses lots of pods per instance (k8s with multiple ENIs). They hit SG limits frequently.

Maria Chen: Yes please. Security groups per ENI -> 40, IPv4 addresses per ENI -> 50 for the time being. Add a note: prefer AZ-balanced allocation and avoid automatic capacity rebalancing if possible.

Andrew Park: Filing the cases now. I'll include scaling plan and baseline throughput: 80 requests/s, average 512-token responses, steady-state 5M tokens/day. Adding cost/team contact info.

quota-bot: Support case opened: case 1357902468 (Increase EC2 quota p5/g5 + ENI/vCPU) - https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/home#/case?caseId=1357902468

Sahil Kapoor: Can we ask account team to pre-check hardware availability? Last time ap-east-1 had limited p5 capacity and we had to fallback to g5. Mention fallback policy in the case: prefer p5, fallback to p4d in emergency, fallback to g5 otherwise.

Maria Chen: Good call. Also flag networking: request ENI quotas in both accounts separately and request limit increases at the AWS service-quotas level (not just EC2 console). Include service-quotas link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/servicequotas/home?region=ap-east-1#/requests

Andrew Park: Done. I added a polite escalation note to the support case and CC'd the aws-account-team@redwood.com. Case number 1357902468. If they reply with capacity constraints we'll open a short-term Dedicated warm pool while AWS schedules capacity.

Sahil Kapoor: One more: please add NAT gateway elastic IP quota increase for the VPCs — we'll be spinning up ~30 NAT gateways across AZs for egress. Also ask for ENI-per-instance confirmation for g5 vs p5 (some older ENI limits prevent >8 ENIs per instance type).

Maria Chen: Added. Thanks all. I'll follow-up with AMT4 PM and ops runbook for failover to Dedicated.

Andrew Park: Follow-up action items: (1) track AWS case 1357902468, (2) validate quotas after AWS confirmation, (3) if capacity not available in 48h -> trigger Dedicated warm pool playbook.

Sahil Kapoor: Tagging eng-sre on this so oncall sees throughput implications: @eng-sre

Maria Chen: Closing loop here. Will post updates to this thread when AWS replies. :thumbsup:
